limitations: Resource thresholds are paired investigation gates. Threshold crossings remain unresolved; successful functional execution does not imply resource acceptance.
Platform quantiles are adaptive, status-grouped observations over combined JSON and SSE windows; their estimated counts are not exact client request counts.
Memory is shared-isolate usage, not per-request peak allocation, a proven leak, or a verified hard upper bound.
Ordinary HTTP EOF is not a waitUntil/background-completion barrier. Client cap 16 does not bound all live isolate work; waitUntil execution and retained memory are not free.
Block filters use script and time, not run ID. Background tails, resets and adjacent same-worker history may overlap; timestamp attribution to start or completion is not established here.
Recorded response colo NRT does not identify an isolate or establish matched compute placement, isolate age, GC state, or true cold starts.
Canaries and earlier lab history may warm isolates and caches. Fixture reset preserves cache/users/upstreams and does not recreate all platform/storage state.
Candidate is frozen commit plus 13 original overlay files; frozen CI used same-lock reused dependencies, not a clean install. No complete source hash was captured at CI launch.
Baseline original upload lacked a launch-time source inventory; later manifest/artifact checks and unchanged active version cannot recreate missing historical launch provenance.
Runner matches original gate SHA; the oracle has the previously disclosed historical change. A/B use the same current oracle, without claiming historical byte identity.
Final dispatch count uses a bounded 500 ms settle. There were no timeouts/aborts in primary; this observation is not an unlimited future-dispatch guarantee.
The comparison is the full repaired candidate versus old baseline. It does not isolate the causal resource effect of JSON-origin compression or support subtraction across earlier sequential pilots.

This ordinary 64 KiB short-output Responses fixture does not establish large/history-dependent requests, cancellation/slow-reader behavior, tools, long reasoning/output, native WS continuations, or the deferred mixed one-hour soak.
Per-cell client N is 200, so client p99 remains unavailable. Platform CPU p99 is a different adaptive statistic.
